title: Avenger Street 160 ABS (Adventure Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Bajaj Auto Avenger Street 160 ABS (Adventure Spec) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 160cc powertrain delivering 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 108 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
